config.description: Predeclared separate projector comparison. No production replacement, ML, COMSOL execution or spectral fitting.
config.scope: Three representative para geometries, two experimental projector extensions. Full-path gaps remain sampled-path gaps, not full-Brillouin-zone certificates. Frozen criteria.yaml supplies gradient tolerance and M=15-relative frequency diagnostic. Higher-M and grid comparisons are reported without changing thresholds. No optimizer is enabled automatically.
